note: The pull-request surface from PLAN.md 5.3, cut down to what a short CI run can afford. It keeps one level of every factor that the method's failure modes attach to -- zero levels, no, some and most DA; both effect directions; sparsity; and the confounded arm -- at a size and rep count that runs in minutes. It is a smoke test of the harness and of the method's gross behaviour, NOT a substitute for the full grid: the per-cell Monte-Carlo error here is far too wide to resolve the 3 SE acceptance rule, so a cell that 'agrees' in this grid has not demonstrated agreement.
